message: 諦めたらそこまでだ

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, won't you let me talk to you one more time?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I won't let you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, please……?」

name: Macaron
message: 「……I'm not in the mood for that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I said I don't care!　Idiot!　Pervert!　I hate you!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't you just making the exact same mistake as yesterday……?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, when you don't know what to do, I figured I'd just go for broke and see what happens」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no point if you actually end up getting broken, though……」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I guess……」

name: Ardin
message: 「Guoooh!　Pa~sta-cha~n!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that startled me--」

name: Paqy
message: 「That idiot face is from the other day……」

name: Synn
message: 「If I remember right…… Ardin, was it?　Did something happen?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Huh?　You're……?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Whaaa--!?　You're the bastard from back then who got in the way of my love life!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't mean to get in your way, though……」

name: Ardin
message: 「Huh?　Come to think of it, that runt from back then said they were on my side……」

name: Ardin
message: 「Which means you're on my side too, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but I have no intention of fighting」

name: Ardin
message: 「Well, as long as you ain't planning on getting in my way, that's fine by me……」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something happen?　You're looking pretty down……」

name: Ardin
message: 「Whoa! You'll actually listen?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah……」

name: Ardin
message: 「So look, I got all psyched up and went to confess to Pasta-chan again today, right……?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did she turn you down?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Don't steal my thunder!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry……」

name: Ardin
message: 「And here I was planning to nail it for sure today……」

name: Ardin
message: 「After getting dumped by Pasta-chan over and over again, my fragile little heart is shattered to pieces!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that sounds rough」

name: Ardin
message: 「Acting like it's none of their business, damn it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, that's not true」

name: Synn
message: 「I think I understand how Ardin feels pretty well, too」

name: Ardin
message: 「I see. So the President's on a losing streak too, huh? How pathetic!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm already sensitive about it...」

name: Ardin
message: 「Well, us hopeless guys oughta stick together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Ardin
message: 「Whoa there! Don't get the wrong idea, though!」

name: Ardin
message: 「I haven't given up on my love for Pasta-chan」

name: Ardin
message: 「If once isn't enough, I'll just polish myself up and keep charging ahead as many times as it takes!」

name: Ardin
message: 「If I do that, I'm sure even stubborn Pasta-chan will open her heart to my sincerity... Hehehe」

name: Synn
message: 「Ardin...」
Trusting the other person's feelings, and conveying your own sincerity to them.
And in doing so, meeting each other halfway.
If one step isn't enough, take another.
Even though it's really just that simple.
Why wasn't I able to realize it.

name: Synn
message: 「...You're amazing, Ardin」

name: Ardin
message: 「Huh? You think so? Uhahaha! Praise me more, dammit!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right... There's no way you should just give up so easily on someone you love」

name: Ardin
message: 「Damn straight!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Once you make up your mind, you see it through to the end! That's what it means to live like a man!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, thank you. Somehow, I feel like I've woken up a little」

name: Ardin
message: 「Heheh, don't sweat it. Let's both live with passion!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right」

name: Ardin
message: 「Well then, I gotta go think up my next plan」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, good luck」

name: Ardin
message: 「You too, Prez! Catch ya later!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Ardin」

name: Synn
message: 「He looks scary, but he's a good guy」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think he's just an idiot, though」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, seeing how straightforward Ardin is really fired me up」

name: Synn
message: 「I love Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「The whole reason I'm doing all this is because I love Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「Until I properly tell her how I feel and find out how she feels...」

name: Synn
message: 「I definitely won't give up」

name: Paqy
message: 「...What's with you, getting totally swept up by him...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Though... well, I guess it ain't bad」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, tomorrow for sure」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't you gonna go see her right now」

name: Synn
message: 「Taking a page out of Ardin's book」

name: Synn
message: 「They say pushy guys get hated, don't they」

name: Paqy
message: 「...I think you're pretty much the same, Demon Lord」

name: Macaron
message: 「...I wonder if Big Brother isn't coming anymore today...」

name: Yasubee
message: 「Eee」

name: Macaron
message: 「N-No, that's not it. That was a strategy to try pushing Big Brother away」

name: Macaron
message: 「I still have zero intention of accepting Big Brother yet」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean, just making up normally would be embarrassing...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, I thought I'd test how serious Big Brother really is」

name: Yasubee
message: 「Eee」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh... what if that made him completely fed up with me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「No, no, it'll definitely be fine」

name: Macaron
message: 「After all, Big Brother is totally dense」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, that's kinda the whole problem though...」
